Create your own theme, choose colors live, and export or restore settings

§ Themes Included in the App
▸ Dark (#000000): Pure OLED black with crisp contrast and maximum battery savings on AMOLED displays.
▸ Deep Blue: A modern, comfortable deep-blue night tone for extended use.
▸ Turquoise Blue: An elegant dark look with vibrant cyan/turquoise highlights.
▸ Light Turquoise: A soft light theme with balanced turquoise accents.
▸ Modern Light: A clean, highly legible light theme for bright environments.

§ Step-by-Step: Change a Theme
1. Open the Menu: Tap the three dots (⋮) in the upper-right corner of the home screen.
2. Open Settings: Select Settings from the list.
3. Choose THEMES: Tap THEMES to open the installed theme gallery.
4. Apply in One Tap: Check the box next to the theme you want. When you return to the main screen, bars, windows, text, icons, and animated effects all change automatically!

§ Edit Individual Colors, Import, and Export
▸ Edit a Theme: In THEMES, tap the pencil (Edit) icon next to any theme to change colors individually (window backgrounds, bars, primary/secondary text, folders, and selection highlights).
▸ Import Themes: Tap Add (+) to import .mit / .mic files or paste a theme copied to the clipboard.
▸ Save/Share: Use Export to create a backup file of your custom theme.

§ Create a Theme and Back Up Settings
▸ My Custom Theme: In the editor, enter a name, choose a base style (OLED, Green, Pink, or Light), then tap one of the six color rows or swatches to open the full spectrum. Drag inside the square to choose saturation and brightness, and along the hue strip to change the color. Quick swatches and RGB/HEX remain available; the preview updates immediately. Tap Save and Apply to add and activate the theme.
▸ Export Full Backup: In Settings, open CUSTOM THEME & BACKUP and choose Export Full Backup. The .arqex.json file stores themes and preferences for restoration.
▸ Export Themes Only: Create a smaller file to carry your custom themes to another device.
▸ Import: Choose a backup in Download/ArqexExplorer or enter the path to a JSON file. The restore reapplies the active theme and settings included in the file.

TIP: Animated borders and dividers automatically adapt to the selected theme palette — no need to reconfigure when switching between light and dark themes!
Animated Visual Effects and Zoom on Open (200 ms)
Theme-adaptive moving borders/dividers and a smooth zoom when tapping

§ Moving Item Borders and Dividers (CSS Style)
▸ Item and Folder Borders: In all view modes (Grid, Gallery, Detailed, Compact, Columns, Wrapped, and Minimal), each folder/thumbnail card shows a synchronized glowing animated outline.
▸ Interface and List Dividers: The top bar, tab bar, bottom bar, and horizontal/vertical separators between files share the same soft light flow.
▸ 100% Theme-Adaptive Colors: The gradient reads the active theme colors dynamically, adjusting brightness and contrast for pure Dark, Turquoise, and light themes.

§ Zoom Effect (200 ms) When Opening Folders/Items
▸ How It Works: Tap a folder or file to open it; the item gently zooms for 200 ms and lifts visually above neighboring items just before opening.
▸ Smart Protection: Prevents accidental double taps during the animation and restores the original scale before opening the next folder.

§ Adjust Zoom Strength
1. Open VISUAL EFFECTS in Settings or through View → Options.
2. With zoom enabled, drag the Zoom strength slider to choose an increase from +2% to +40%. The label shows the selected value.
3. Tap Test or the preview to see the animation. Default restores the initial +13%; the setting is saved.

§ Turn Effects On or Off
1. In Settings: Menu (⋮) → Settings → VISUAL EFFECTS.
2. In the View menu: Tap View → Options... → Visual Effects.
3. Quick shortcut: Use the Configure Visual Effects button below to toggle either effect instantly!
Universal Size Slider and the 7 View Modes
Resize Gallery, Grid, Detailed, and every other mode live

§ Size Slider in “View”
1. Open the View panel: Tap View in the bottom (or top) bar.
2. Adjust live: Use the slider at the top of the window or tap [ − ] to decrease and [ + ] to increase. The window has a subtle transparent background so you can watch items resize in real time!
3. Default button: Tap Default to instantly restore that mode’s original 100% size.
4. Automatic persistence in subfolders: The selected size is saved separately for each mode and remains active in subfolders and after restarting the app!

§ All 7 View Modes Explained
▸ Compact: Tight columns show many files at once.
▸ Columns: Aligns names and details in horizontal columns.
▸ Detailed: A full list with icon, complete name, size, date, and attributes (freely adjustable from 52% to 180% on the slider!).
▸ Wrapped: Long names can use multiple lines instead of ellipses.
▸ Minimal: An ultra-clean view focused on icon and name.
▸ Grid: Square cards with large icons/thumbnails and labels below (adjustable from one large column to ten compact columns!).
▸ Gallery: A photo mosaic ideal for photos and videos — slide left to reduce size significantly (5, 6, 8, or 10 columns) or right to enlarge.

§ Sorting and Extra Options
▸ Sort: By Name (A–Z / Z–A), Date, Size, or Type.
▸ Options...: Control thumbnails, folders before files, grouped sections, fast scrolling, and automatic calculation of folder sizes.
Top-Bar Shortcuts, Selection, and Empty Folders
Copy paths, show hidden files, calculate total size, and clean up selectively

§ Quick Buttons on the Main Screen’s Top Bar
▸ Copy Path icon: Tap once to copy the full path of the open folder to the clipboard (long-press shows the feature name).
▸ Eye icon (Hidden Files): Instantly show or hide folders and files whose names begin with a dot (.nomedia, .git, .config). When enabled, the eye glows in the theme accent color!
▸ ? icon (Help): Open this complete guide from any folder with one tap.
▸ “Tasks” button: Jump directly to the Automatic Tasks panel.

§ Smart “Delete Empty Folders” Button
▸ Automatic detection: Appears discreetly over the page only when the current folder contains empty subfolders (without pushing the file list down).
▸ Selective checkboxes: Tap it to see all detected empty folders checked. Uncheck any folder you want to keep before confirming deletion.

§ Improved Multi-Selection (Long Press)
▸ Stable layout: Long-pressing to select files never shifts the list beneath your finger.
▸ Accurate total size (folders + files): Calculates the real combined size of selected files and subfolders in the background.
▸ Copy selected paths: In the selection bar, tap Copy Path to copy the complete list of paths for selected items.
Real-time monitoring, extension filters, silent mode, and per-task Play button

§ Create a Background Automation
1. Open the panel: Tap “Tasks” in the top bar (or Settings → More settings → Automatic Tasks).
2. Add a task: Tap Add (+), enter a name, and choose a trigger:
▸ WHEN FILE IS DETECTED (Real Time): Continuously watches the selected folder in the background and moves or copies new files as soon as they are downloaded or created!
▸ Scheduled time / interval: Runs at fixed times or recurring intervals.

§ Advanced Task Controls
▸ Move or Copy: Choose whether detected files are moved or copied to the destination folder.
▸ Files in this folder only: When checked, ignores subfolders and processes only files directly inside the watched folder.
▸ Extension filter: Enter comma-separated extensions (e.g., jpg, png, pdf, apk) to process only the chosen file types.
▸ Automatic prefix: Add a custom prefix to the names of processed files.
▸ Show notification when finished: Turn this off to run silently without the “Operation completed” notification.
▸ Per-task Play button (▶): Tap ▶ on any task in the list to run it manually right away!
File Operations, Folder Creation, and Permissions (chmod)
Copy/move queue, direct deletion, open-on-create, and interactive rwx picker

§ Copy, Move, and the Arqex Explorer Task Queue
1. Select items: Long-press one or more files or folders.
2. Add to the queue: Tap Copy or Cut/Move.
3. Run at the destination: Browse to the destination folder, tap the Task Queue icon (clipboard in the top bar), and confirm to start. The current folder refreshes automatically when the operation finishes.

§ Fast and Safe Deletion
▸ Permanent by default: Permanent deletion is preselected to speed up your workflow; Trash (Undo) and Shred remain available.

§ Create Folders/Files (+) and Interactive Permissions
▸ Open folder after creation: In New Folder (+ → Folder), keep the option checked to enter the newly created folder automatically.
▸ Interactive permissions picker (Root / chmod): When creating a folder or file on a partition that supports Unix permissions, tap the Permissions field (e.g., 755 or 644) to open a grid of Read (R), Write (W), Execute (X), SetUID, SetGID, and Sticky checkboxes!

§ Advanced Batch Rename
▸ Select multiple files and tap Rename to use sequential numbering, date/time, Regex, and uppercase/lowercase conversion.
Full backup of regular apps and split app bundles

§ Where to Find Installed Apps
1. Open Favorites: Tap the side-menu icon (☰) in the upper-left corner or swipe in from the left edge.
2. Choose Apps: View all user and system apps with their version, size, and date.

§ Create a Complete Backup
▸ Regular apps (.apk): Select a standard app and copy it to any storage folder to save its installer intact.
▸ Split APKs (.apks): Modern Play Store apps use multiple packages (base.apk plus language, screen-density, and arm64 architecture splits). Arqex Explorer automatically bundles base.apk and every split into one complete .apks file!
▸ Restore / Install: Tap any saved .apk or .apks file to start installation directly in Arqex Explorer.
Compression, Extraction (ZIP, 7Z, RAR, TAR), and APK Signing
Browse archives without extracting, protect them with a password, and sign APKs

§ Open Compressed Files Like Folders
▸ Instant browsing: Tap any .zip, .7z, .rar, .tar, .gz, .xz, .iso, or .apk to open it like a normal folder, view images/text inside, or copy just one file!

§ Create Compressed and Protected Archives
1. Select the files or folders you want.
2. Open the action menu (⋮) and choose Archive.
3. Choose a format (ZIP, 7Z, TAR, GZIP, BZIP2, XZ), compression level (from Store to Ultra), and optionally set a strong AES-256 encrypted password.

§ Extract and Sign Packages
▸ Extract: Select an archive and choose Extract to unpack it into the current folder, a new subfolder, or the adjacent tab.
▸ Sign APK/ZIP: Select an .apk file and choose Menu (⋮) → Sign, with Android v1, v2, and v3 scheme support.
Built-in Editors and Viewers (Code, Media, SQLite, Hex)
Syntax-aware code editor, audio/video player, PDF, Hex, and hashes

§ Advanced Code and Text Editor
▸ Features: Smoothly handles very large files, line numbering, syntax highlighting (XML, JSON, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Java, Kotlin, Python, Shell, Smali), Regex search/replace, and encoding selection (UTF-8, ANSI, UTF-16).

§ Gallery, Media Player, and Readers
▸ Image viewer: Precise zoom, slideshows, animated GIF, WebP, SVG, and EXIF data.
▸ Audio and video player: Play music and videos without leaving the file manager, including quick audio previews.
▸ Document reader: Built-in viewers for PDF, ePub, HTML, Markdown, and fonts (.ttf / .otf).

§ Technical Tools (SQLite, Hex, and Hashes)
▸ SQLite editor: Open .db / .sqlite databases to browse tables, filter records, and run SQL commands.
▸ Hex viewer: Inspect and edit raw bytes in binary files.
▸ Hash checker: In Properties (i), calculate and compare MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512, and CRC32.
Wi-Fi Servers (HTTP, FTP, SMB) and Cloud Storage
Transfer files with a PC without a cable and connect cloud/NAS storage

§ Transfer Files with a PC without a USB Cable
1. Start a server: Open Menu (⋮) → Servers.
2. Choose a protocol:
▸ HTTP / WebDAV server: Shows a local link (e.g., http://192.168.1.10:8080). Enter it in a browser on your computer or another phone on the same Wi-Fi network to upload and download files!
▸ FTP / FTPS / SFTP and SMB server: Lets you open phone folders directly in Windows Explorer, macOS Finder, or FTP clients.
3. Customize: Set the port, password, and starting folder in Settings → More settings → Servers.

§ Connect to Local Networks (LAN) and Cloud Services
▸ Add a connection: Open Favorites (☰) → top menu → Add storage.
▸ Supported protocols: SMBv1/v2/v3 (Windows/NAS shared folders), SFTP/SSH, FTP/FTPS, WebDAV, and cloud services such as Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, MEGA, Box, pCloud, and Nextcloud.
Encryption (EncFS / AES), Recursive Search, and Duplicates
Password-protected folders, deep content search, and cleanup

§ Protect Folders and Files with a Password
▸ EncFS vault: Tap (+) → EncFS Folder to create a password-encrypted directory. Enter the password to unlock it; when finished, use Menu (⋮) → Unmount/Lock.
▸ AESCipher files (.enc): Encrypt individual files by selecting them and choosing Menu (⋮) → Encrypt.

§ Quick Search, Recursive Search, and Duplicates
▸ Instant filter: Tap Search to filter items in the open folder in real time.
▸ Deep subfolder search: In the search bar, tap Recursive Search to search by regular expression, type, size, date, or even text inside file contents!
▸ Find duplicates: Identify repeated files to safely free up space.
Multiple Tabs, Dual Pane, Favorites, and Settings Backup
Tab navigation gestures, button customization, and .mic export

§ Mastering Tabs and Dual Pane
▸ Swipe between tabs: Swipe left or right to switch between several folders open at once.
▸ Tab menu: Tap the current tab title to open New tab, Clone tab, Close other tabs, Set as default tab, or Save current tabs.
▸ Dual pane: Ideal in landscape or on larger screens for dragging files directly from one tab to another to copy or move them.

§ Favorites Drawer (☰) and Full Customization
▸ Smart shortcuts: Quickly access Internal Storage, SD, Root (/), Recent, Images, Videos, Audio, Documents, and Apps.
▸ Customize buttons: In Settings → BUTTONS, enable, disable, or reorder icons in each app bar.
▸ App-wide backup: Use Settings → CUSTOM THEME & BACKUP → Export Full Backup to save themes and preferences in .arqex.json; then use Import to restore. Native .mic/.mit theme formats remain available in the THEMES panel.
Customize Zoom and Create / Export Themes
Set zoom strength and take your look and settings to another device

§ Zoom Strength on Open
In Settings or View → Options → Visual Effects, enable Zoom on open and drag Zoom strength to choose from +2% to +40%. Tap Test to preview the effect; Default resets it to +13%.

§ Make the Theme Your Own
In Settings, open CUSTOM THEME & BACKUP and choose Create / Edit My Theme. Enter a name, choose a preset, and tap any row or square to open the palette. Pick a swatch or adjust RGB/HEX values. The preview updates as you edit. Save and Apply adds the custom theme to the THEMES selector.

§ Export, Share, and Restore
Export Full Backup saves themes and preferences in an .arqex.json file. Export Themes Only creates a smaller package. To restore, choose Import Themes / Settings and select a listed file or enter its path. The file is saved in Download/ArqexExplorer when Android allows access; otherwise, use the app’s external files folder.
